verdict.rationale: cubic documents its own fix capability: 'Fix with cubic' generates a fix for a review finding and pushes it to the PR branch. That loosely covers fixing code-quality and lint-style issues it flags. Nothing in the evidence shows it writing tests, resolving merge conflicts or updating dependencies. Missing for 10: test generation, explicit lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updates, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
By default, cubic pushes commits directly to your PR branch.
